verdict.rationale: The evidence only glances at third-party UI libraries. One user ran Ionic 2 mobile apps on Angular, an AngularJS user cites 'lots of books and directives', and the CLI documents adding external libraries. Against that, one user found Angular 2's UI libraries lacking (material2 in alpha) and another called third-party libraries 'of middling quality'. There is no vendor claim of a rich ecosystem to contradict, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: documented catalog or breadth of third-party UI component libraries for modern Angular, evidence of quality and maturity of those libraries, independent corroboration of ecosystem richness.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pick from a rich ecosystem of third-party pre-built UI component libraries for the framework

citations.quote: Adds support for an external library to your project.
